hook: A rescue basket dropped onto a moving bow, 60 miles out.
narration: This basket had to land on the bow of a moving fishing boat, sixty miles out.
A fisherman aboard the Gladiator Two needed a hospital, far off South Carolina.
A Coast Guard Dolphin crew from Air Facility Charleston lowered the basket from the door.
The boat holds a steady course and speed, which gives the pilot a stable target to hover over.
He climbed in at the bow, and the flight mechanic brought him up over open water.
outcome: And the Dolphin crew flew him to a medical facility in Georgetown.

location_card.place: 60 miles southeast of Georgetown, South Carolina

title: Basket onto a moving bow, 60 miles out
description:
On Aug. 31, 2011, a Coast Guard MH-65C Dolphin crew from Air Facility Charleston hoisted a fisherman from the fishing vessel Gladiator II, about 60 miles southeast of Georgetown, South Carolina, and flew him to a medical facility in Georgetown.
